title: Safeguards to Prevent Loss of CPF Savings Through Malware-related Scams
what_it_is: Safeguards to Prevent Loss of CPF Savings Through Malware-related Scams

sections.label: Malware scam reports and CPF losses
sections.summary: Since January 2023, Police received over 700 malware reports with over $8 million lost, including nine CPF cases with $124,000 net loss.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Since January 2023, the Police received more than 700 reports of victims having downloaded malware onto their phones, with more than $8 million worth of savings lost through unauthorised withdrawals from the victims' bank accounts and so on.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Based on the investigations thus far, nine of these cases involved unauthorised Central Provident Fund (CPF) withdrawals, amounting to a net loss of $124,000 in CPF savings.

sections.label: CPF and GovTech authentication measures
sections.summary: CPF Board and GovTech introduced additional authentication measures from 22 June 2023 to increase protection for CPF members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: As a further precaution, CPF Board and GovTech have introduced additional authentication measures since 22 June 2023 to increase the protection for CPF members.

sections.label: Net loss of CPF savings
sections.summary: Investigations show the net loss of CPF savings amounts to $124,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Based on investigations, the net loss of CPF savings amounts to $124,000.

sections.label: Government engagement and consultation paper
sections.summary: The Government is engaging industry stakeholders and plans a public consultation paper in the third quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Currently, the Government is engaging very closely with all the different industry stakeholders and we will continue to do so.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: There is a plan for a public consultation paper to come out in the third quarter of this year.

sections.label: Singpass Face Verification for vulnerable members
sections.summary: Vulnerable members need an additional step of Singpass Face Verification as an added precautionary measure.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: That then exposes themselves to all these scammers to then undertake and take over their information.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, the added precautionary measure that we have put up is that for vulnerable members, they would need an additional step of using the Singpass Face Verification.

sections.label: Measures to prevent unauthorised CPF withdrawals
sections.summary: Education on not downloading apps, not enabling accessibility services, not sharing details, and Singpass Face Verification are sufficient to prevent unauthorised CPF withdrawals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I cannot tell you how members will want to store their passwords to remind themselves.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But I think the added measure today, first of constantly educating our public to not download any form of innocuous-looking apps from unauthorised stores, unauthorised sites and also to not just switch on the accessibility services; and at the same time, not release details to someone who is unknown over the phone and at the same time adding on the additional security verification through the Singpass Face Verification step, I think it is sufficient for us to prevent, today, unauthorised withdrawals from the CPF account.

sections.label: Cybersecurity and Government precautions
sections.summary: Cybersecurity evolves as scammers and hackers get more creative, and the Government will find new ways to protect members.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Because today, cybersecurity constantly evolves – scammers and hackers are getting more and more creative.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: At the same time, the Government will also constantly find new ways to step up our precaution to protect our members.
